comparable_prior_wave.name: GLP-1 / obesity wave 2022-2025 (drug makers and cash-pay telehealth)
comparable_prior_wave.similar: Consumer weight-loss / metabolic spend surged; NAGE itself ran 12.1x (2022-09 to 2025-06) in the same window (tools.py px)
comparable_prior_wave.different: This is the wreckage of that wave, not a first wave: the value accrued to drug owners (LLY still at high, 4.9x) and a telehealth distributor (HIMS 18.3x, now -67%); MED and NAGE are fading participants. A second wave is a different, unevidenced claim.

themes.wave_score_reason: The metabolic-health wave already happened and crested in drug owners; these filings show shrinking revenue and no contract-level adoption evidence for the members.

comparable_prior_wave.name: 2020-2021 digital-health / cloud-software wave
comparable_prior_wave.similar: Same issuers, same thesis (software + data to cut healthcare / service cost); EVH ran 9.4x 2020-03 to 2021-10, FIVN 5.1x into 2021-08, HCAT and TDOC peaked 2021 (tools.py px)
comparable_prior_wave.different: These names are wreckage of that wave; the current claim is a second (AI) wave, which the filings support only weakly (one acquisition at FIVN, shrinking revenue at HCAT, rising risk reserves at EVH). Even the first wave produced <10x for leaders, far short of 25x.

themes.wave_score_reason: Real revenue and some AI M&A exist, but adoption evidence in the filings is mixed-to-negative and the prior wave in the same names topped out at 5-9x.
